mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_provider_config (org_id, provider, region, model_id, credential_ref, credential_last4, no_training_attested, attested_at, enabled) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{provider}, #{region}, #{modelId}, #{credentialRef}, #{credentialLast4}, #{noTrainingAttested}, #{attestedAt}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), region = VALUES(region), model_id = VALUES(model_id), credential_ref = VALUES(credential_ref), credential_last4 = VALUES(credential_last4), no_training_attested = VALUES(no_training_attested), attested_at = VALUES(attested_at), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
